name: Threshold from 1 April 2022: twenty crore rupees

attrs.quote: with effect from the 1st day of April, 2022, for the words ―fifty crore rupees‖, the words ―twenty crore rupees‖ shall be substituted
attrs.scope: registered persons whose aggregate turnover in any preceding financial year from 2017-18 onwards exceeds the threshold, for supplies to registered persons or for exports
